basis: Stem-cell peptide restricting WUS; CZ-specific in situ/reporter (Fletcher et al. 1999 Science). Rare: not a cluster DE gene in either atlas; Xu 2025 found 392 CLV3+ cells inside the meristem clusters (Fig 1G).
Cytokinin-activating LONELY GUY; CLV3 co-expression rank 2 (r=0.25) and DE in the L1 meristem cluster 3 (0.26 vs 0.11) of Xu 2025 only. Not shown CZ-specific by in situ.
bZIP TF PERIANTHIA; CLV3 co-expression rank 30 and weak DE in inner-meristem cluster 2 (0.26 vs 0.12) of Xu 2025; conserved with maize FEA4 (Xu 2025). Single study.

Homeodomain TF defining the organizing center below the CZ (Mayer et al. 1998 Cell). Rare: not a cluster DE gene in either atlas; Xu 2025 "organizing center" clusters are stress states (WUS not DE), so find WUS+ cells by expression.

KNOX TF required for SAM maintenance, SAM in situ (Long et al. 1996 Nature); DE in meristem clusters of both atlases (Zhang c13 0.48/0.09; Xu c2 0.73/0.42). Pan-meristem (CZ+PZ+rib), absent from primordia; also in G2/M inner-meristem cells (Xu c15).

KNOX TF expressed in SAM corpus (Lincoln et al. 1994 Plant Cell); DE in Zhang meristem c13 (0.43/0.08). Conflict: in Xu 2025 DE only in the photosynthetic "rib zone" c6 (0.29/0.10), consistent with BP expression in stem cortex/rib; not apex-specific.
KNOX TF expressed in SAM and organ boundaries (Belles-Boix et al. 2006 Plant Cell); DE in Zhang meristem c13 (0.43/0.09) only.

Uncharacterized; in situ in the vegetative SAM (Zhang 2021 Fig 7I; image not inspected). Not specific in data: also DE in Zhang epidermal c2/c14 and leaf c4, and in Xu epidermal c4. Use only with STM.
Auxin-amido synthetase; in situ in the vegetative SAM (Zhang 2021 Fig 7J; image not inspected); DE only in Zhang meristem c13 (0.49/0.08).
P450 KLUH; in situ at the SAM periphery (Zondlo & Irish 1999 Plant J); top DE of Zhang meristem c13 (0.62/0.04) and DE in Xu inner meristem c2 (0.37/0.14): two independent atlases.
ALOG protein; boundary reporter (Cho & Zambryski 2011 PNAS); DE in Zhang meristem c13 (0.53/0.08). Xu: weak DE in lateral-organ c0 only (0.45/0.36).
NAC TF establishing meristem-organ boundaries, boundary in situ (Vroemen et al. 2003 Plant Cell). Not DE in either atlas (Xu Fig S1S UMAP only; Xu called it "periphery").

AP2 TF in organ primordia, in situ (Elliott et al. 1996 Plant Cell); Arabidopsis in situ Xu 2025 Fig 2C (figure says CHO1/EMK/AIL5, Table S5 probe is ANT). DE in Zhang G2 procambium c19 only; not a clean cluster marker.
YABBY TF of the abaxial side of lateral organ primordia (Siegfried et al. 1999 Development). Weak DE in Xu lateral-organ c0 (0.36/0.23) and c6; abaxial domain only.
YABBY TF of abaxial lateral-organ cells (Siegfried et al. 1999 Development). Weak DE in Xu c4 only; abaxial domain only.
HD-ZIP IV TF specifying L1/epidermis; pATML1::sGFP reporter in Zhang 2021 (Fig 8I); DE in epidermal clusters of both atlases (Zhang c2 0.57/0.08; Xu c3/c4/c8 ~0.42/0.12). Includes meristem L1.
HD-ZIP IV TF acting redundantly with ATML1 in epidermis specification (Abe et al. 2003 Development); DE in epidermal clusters of both atlases (Zhang c2 0.58/0.09; Xu c3 0.45/0.12).
L1-specific in situ (Abe et al. 1999 Plant J); top epidermal DE in both atlases (Zhang c2 0.85/0.24; Xu c3 0.92/0.26). Also in L1 S/G2M and stomatal-lineage cells.
Epidermis-specific VLCFA condensing enzyme for cuticle (Yephremov et al. 1999 Plant Cell; Pruitt et al. 2000 PNAS); DE in epidermal clusters of both atlases (Zhang c2 0.81/0.13; Xu c3 0.68/0.17).
BAHD acyltransferase for cutin, epidermis-expressed (Panikashvili et al. 2009 Plant Physiol); DE in epidermal clusters of both atlases (Zhang c2 0.67/0.12; Xu c3 0.70/0.16).
GPI-anchored LTP for cuticular wax, epidermis-expressed (DeBono et al. 2009 Plant Cell); DE in epidermal clusters of both atlases (Zhang c2 0.94/0.20; Xu c3 0.91/0.45, less specific).
Lipid transfer protein; top DE of epidermal clusters in both atlases (Zhang c2 0.73/0.15; Xu c3 0.94/0.38). Enrichment only.

HD-ZIP IV TF, L1 expression (Nakamura et al. 2006 Plant Physiol), enriched in stomatal-lineage meristemoids (Peterson et al. 2013 Plant Cell); DE in Zhang stomatal c18 (0.41/0.05) and Xu L1 meristem c3 (0.32/0.09).
bHLH initiating stomatal lineage, MMC/meristemoid reporter (MacAlister et al. 2007 Nature); DE in Zhang stomatal c18 (0.57/0.03) and c12.
Secreted peptide from MMCs/meristemoids limiting entry divisions (Hara et al. 2009 Plant Cell Physiol; Hunt & Gray 2009 Curr Biol); DE in Zhang c18 (0.54/0.02).
Receptor-like protein in stomatal-lineage cells (Nadeau & Sack 2002 Science); DE in Zhang c18 (0.77/0.04).
Polarity protein of stomatal asymmetric divisions (Pillitteri et al. 2011 Plant Cell); DE in Zhang c12 (0.57/0.03) and c18.
Polarity protein of stomatal asymmetric divisions (Dong et al. 2009 Cell); DE in Zhang c12/c18 (0.33/0.01).
bHLH for GMC-to-guard-cell transition, GMC/young GC reporter (Ohashi-Ito & Bergmann 2006 Plant Cell); DE in Zhang guard c11 (0.46/0.01).
Guard-cell-specific MYB regulating aperture, promoter GUS (Cominelli et al. 2005 Curr Biol); DE in Zhang c11 (0.45/0.01).
Guard-cell R-type anion channel, GC reporter (Meyer et al. 2010 Plant J); DE in Zhang c11 (0.34/0.00).
Guard-cell-specific DOF TF needed for GC maturation (Negi et al. 2013 Curr Biol); DE in Zhang c11 (0.30/0.01).
Secreted stomatal-spacing peptide expressed in late meristemoids, GMCs and young GCs (Hara et al. 2007 Genes Dev); DE in Zhang guard c11 (0.42/0.00). Marks young guard cells and GMCs, not mature GCs.
Mesophyll-secreted peptide promoting stomatal density (Sugano et al. 2010 Nature; Kondo et al. 2010 Plant Cell Physiol); DE in Xu photosynthetic "rib zone" c6 (0.27/0.02) only. Young leaves/bracts.
Uncharacterized; promoter H2B-sGFP reporter in mesophyll (Zhang 2021 Fig S2F-G). Not in Zhang Table S1 DE list: check enrichment in data.
Actin depolymerizing factor; pADF9::H2B-sGFP reporter in shoot endodermis/bundle sheath (Zhang 2021 Fig 3A-C; image not inspected); DE in Zhang SEn c20 (0.60/0.02).
Class III peroxidase; promoter H2B-sGFP reporter in shoot endodermis/bundle sheath (Zhang 2021 Fig 3E-G; image not inspected); DE in Zhang c20 (0.29/0.00).
Shoot gravitropism gene expressed in shoot endodermis (Yoshihara et al. 2013 Plant Cell Physiol); DE in Zhang SEn c20 (0.47/0.02). Shoot endodermis (starch sheath) rather than leaf bundle sheath.
SHOOT GRAVITROPISM 6, endodermis-acting gravitropism gene; mutant examined in Zhang 2021 (Fig 3J); weakly DE in Zhang c20 (0.26/0.03).
TDIF receptor in procambium, reporter (Fisher & Turner 2007 Curr Biol); DE in Zhang xylem-side c10 (0.65/0.07) and G2 procambium c19.
HD-ZIP III TF marking procambium/xylem precursors (Baima et al. 1995 Development); DE in Zhang c10 (0.57/0.04).

bHLH specifying xylem precursors with LHW (De Rybel et al. 2013 Dev Cell; Ohashi-Ito et al. 2014 Curr Biol); in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S7A; image not inspected), DE in Zhang c10 (0.39/0.04) and Xu "xylem" c5 (0.25/0.07). Xylem precursor, not mature xylem.
TMO5-LIKE1 bHLH in xylem precursors (De Rybel et al. 2013 Dev Cell); DE in Zhang c10 (0.41/0.01). Xu used it for "xylem" c5 by UMAP but it is not DE there.
Thermospermine synthase specific to xylem vessel precursors, reporter (Muniz et al. 2008 Development); top DE of Zhang c10 (0.59/0.03).
Tracheary-element-differentiation-related LTP-like protein; DE in Zhang c10 (0.65/0.07, also c6) and Xu "xylem" c5 (0.29/0.02): two atlases.
Germin-like protein; in situ in xylem-side vasculature (Zhang 2021 Fig S7A; image not inspected); DE in Zhang c10 (0.57/0.02).
Fasciclin-like AGP of secondary-wall cells; DE in Zhang c10 (0.36/0.01).
Phosphate exporter loading the xylem, expressed in stelar/xylem parenchyma (Hamburger et al. 2002 Plant Cell); DE in Zhang c6 (0.37/0.03). Root-defined; shoot expression from Zhang only.
Low-affinity sulfate transporter, xylem parenchyma/pericycle reporter (Takahashi et al. 2000 Plant J); top DE of Zhang c6 (0.68/0.12).
Glycine-rich protein (uncharacterized); in situ in vasculature (Zhang 2021 Fig S7A; image not inspected); DE in Zhang c6 (0.50/0.06).
Glycine-rich protein (uncharacterized); in situ in vasculature (Zhang 2021 Fig S7A; image not inspected); DE in Zhang c6 (0.43/0.03) and Xu "xylem" c5 (0.41/0.17, less specific).

bZIP TF expressed in phloem (Silveira et al. 2007 Plant Physiol); in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S7A); DE in Zhang c7 (0.50/0.02) and Xu phloem c12 (0.44/0.03, also CC/SE). Early phloem/phloem parenchyma side.
PEAR DOF TF of the phloem-pole procambium (Miyashima et al. 2019 Nature); in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S7A); DE in Zhang c19/c7 (0.70/0.09) and Xu phloem c12 (0.66/0.14).
CLE peptide expressed in developing phloem (Ren et al. 2019 Plant Physiol); DE in Zhang c19/c7 (0.62/0.05) and Xu phloem c12 (0.29/0.02).
SMXL5 needed for phloem formation, expressed in early phloem (Wallner et al. 2017 Curr Biol); DE in Zhang c19/c7 (0.51/0.06) and Xu phloem c12 (0.34/0.04).
Uncharacterized; in situ in phloem-side vasculature (Zhang 2021 Fig S7A; image not inspected); DE in Zhang c7/c19 (0.38/0.04) and Xu phloem c12 (0.38/0.03).
MYB TF for phloem (SE and CC) identity, reporter (Bonke et al. 2003 Nature); DE in CC and SE clusters of both atlases (Zhang c15/c22; Xu c16/c17 0.86/0.01). Pan-phloem (SE+CC).

Sucrose-H+ symporter loading the phloem, CC-specific reporter (Truernit & Sauer 1995 Planta); DE in CC clusters of both atlases (Zhang c15 0.72/0.05; Xu c16 0.85/0.00). SUC2 clade is eudicot-specific (grasses use SUT1).
Plasma-membrane H+-ATPase energizing phloem loading, CC GUS (DeWitt & Sussman 1995 Plant Cell); DE in CC clusters of both atlases (Zhang c15 0.88/0.03; Xu c16 0.85/0.02), also SE clusters.
ER protein exporting FT from companion cells (Liu et al. 2012 PLoS Biol); DE in CC clusters of both atlases (Zhang c15 0.36/0.01; Xu c16 0.45/0.00).
Phloem protein 2 lectin made in companion cells (Dinant et al. 2003 Plant Physiol); DE in CC clusters of both atlases (Zhang c15 0.86/0.11; Xu c16 0.48/0.00).

Heavy-metal-associated protein expressed in companion cells, mutant affects phloem (Tian et al. 2010 Plant Cell); DE in Zhang c15 (0.69/0.02) and Xu c16 (0.86/0.14). Conflict: also DE in Xu stress cluster c10 (0.54/0.13).
Amino acid permease; DE in CC clusters of both atlases (Zhang c15 0.60/0.07, also c6; Xu c16 0.82/0.00). CC localization not shown by reporter.

Sieve-element occlusion (P-protein) gene, SE reporter (Froelich et al. 2011 Plant Cell); DE in SE clusters of both atlases (Zhang c22 0.93/0.01; Xu c17 0.85/0.00). SEO family is eudicot-specific. Developing (nucleate) SEs only.
Sieve-element occlusion gene (Froelich et al. 2011 Plant Cell); DE in SE clusters of both atlases (Zhang c22 0.95/0.01; Xu c17 0.90/0.00). SEO family is eudicot-specific.

Phloem-specific callose synthase for sieve-plate callose, SE reporter (Xie et al. 2011 Plant Cell; Barratt et al. 2011 PNAS); DE in SE clusters of both atlases (Zhang c22 0.61/0.00; Xu c17 0.78/0.01).
Phytocyanin-like early-nodulin, SE-specific (Khan et al. 2007 Plant Physiol); in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S7A); DE in SE clusters of both atlases (Zhang c22 0.80/0.00; Xu c17 0.75/0.00).
Uncharacterized; in situ in developing SEs (Zhang 2021 Fig S7A; image not inspected); most specific SE gene in both atlases (Zhang c22 0.98/0.01; Xu c17 0.97/0.00).
GATA TF; in situ in developing SEs (Zhang 2021 Fig S7A; image not inspected); DE in SE clusters of both atlases (Zhang c22 0.62/0.01; Xu c17 0.73/0.01).

PEAR-family DOF of the protophloem/phloem pole (Miyashima et al. 2019 Nature); in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S7A); DE in SE clusters of both atlases (Zhang c22 0.47/0.02; Xu c17 0.71/0.02), weaker in early phloem.
PEAR-family DOF expressed in protophloem SEs (Miyashima et al. 2019 Nature); DE in SE clusters of both atlases (Zhang c22 0.60/0.02; Xu c17 0.63/0.01). arabidopsis_root.tsv lists it as Phloem.
Cytokinesis syntaxin expressed in M phase (Lukowitz et al. 1996 Cell); DE in G2/M clusters of both atlases (Zhang c9 0.84/0.08; Xu c14 0.69/0.04).
G2/M-specific CDK; DE in G2/M clusters of both atlases (Zhang c9/c17/c19; Xu c15 0.83/0.07). Xu used it to define G2/M.
Mitotic cyclin, G2/M reporter (Colon-Carmona et al. 1999 Plant J); DE in G2/M clusters of both atlases (Zhang c9 0.29/0.03; Xu c14 0.48/0.03).
GRAS TF of the G2/M program; in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S4M); DE in G2/M clusters of both atlases (Zhang c9 0.63/0.03; Xu c14 0.52/0.01).
Early nodulin-like; in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S4J); DE in G2/M clusters of both atlases (Zhang c9 0.80/0.06; Xu c14 0.58/0.02).
LRR receptor-like kinase; in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S4K); DE in G2/M clusters of both atlases (Zhang c9 0.52/0.02; Xu c14 0.52/0.01).
RNA Pol II elongation factor-like (uncharacterized); in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S4L); DE in G2/M clusters of both atlases (Zhang c9 0.60/0.03; Xu c14 0.52/0.01).

Replication-dependent histone H3.1, S-phase in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S4F); DE in S-phase clusters of both atlases (Zhang c5 0.96/0.16; Xu c11 0.58/0.06). H3.1 genes (AT5G10390, AT5G10400, AT5G65360, AT1G09200, AT3G27360) encode one protein: multimapping reads.
Histone H4, S-phase in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S4I); DE in S-phase clusters of both atlases (Zhang c5 0.89/0.21; Xu c11 0.85/0.17). Eight H4 genes encode one protein.
Replication-coupled histone H2A.W, in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S4G, called H2A6); DE in S-phase clusters of both atlases (Zhang c5 0.97/0.17; Xu c11 0.95/0.16).
Histone H2B, in situ in Zhang 2021 (Fig S4H); DE in S-phase clusters of both atlases (Zhang c5 0.85/0.23; Xu c11 0.96/0.39).
